slowStructuralTrial.explanation: Exact-text replacements without trailing newline join the next line. Snapshots show Goose repeatedly moving/fixing these joined boundaries, rereading and rechecking after each passing change. This is an editing-contract/workflow gap; AST execution is not the direct latency bottleneck.

traceFindings.rename: First candidate used real LSP, reviewed and applied a 14-file plan after one correctly rejected STALE_SCOPE attempt following test-file creation. Second candidate used only ordinary developer tools. The combined rename speedup cannot be credited entirely to LSP.
traceFindings.diagnostics: Two optional diagnostics calls in first structural candidate, 444/402 ms; no diagnostic timeouts.

remainingWork: Make whole-line edit boundaries reliable, preserving the appropriate LF/CRLF unless exact joining is requested; cover middle-file, deletion and EOF behavior with tests.
Reduce avoidable inference/read/check cycles by applying one complete coherent batch; skip unchanged-context reinspection without suppressing validation after real edits.

Use AST/LSP for concrete structural or binding questions; simple tasks should keep ordinary tool workflow. Current mode is advisory, with all four schemas advertised, not automatic task classification.
startup: Initial package failed before Send/model calls while Chromium cookie encryption key load awaited Keychain. Preserved separately. Disposable benchmark profiles used the official Electron mock-cookie-Keychain switch equally in both arms; real parent OAuth and TLS fingerprint validation unchanged. This is not a product fix.
limitations: Two repetitions per task/arm; exploratory, not statistical equivalence.
Equal weighting of three tasks is not a typical daily workload.
Historical v4 and current v7 batches are not a matched release-vs-release causal comparison.
No automatic task classifier or dynamically hidden tool schemas implemented.
